catexcompare between inventory trx and onhand qty .txt
content:
select ML.LINE, sum (H.QTYONHAND) ,ML.MOVEMENTQTY  
from M_Movement m
inner join M_Movementline ml on M.M_MOVEMENT_ID = ML.M_MOVEMENT_ID
inner join M_STORAGEONHAND h on ML.M_PRODUCT_ID  = H.M_PRODUCT_ID
-- where ml.M_MOVEMENTline_ID in (select ml.M_MOVEMENTline_ID from M_Movementline where  M.M_MOVEMENT_ID = 1001541)
where ml.m_product_id in (select m_product_id from m_movementline where ml.M_MOVEMENTline_ID in (select ml.M_MOVEMENTline_ID from M_Movementline where  M.M_MOVEMENT_ID = 1001541))
and h.m_locator_id = 1000258
group by ml.line,ML.MOVEMENTQTY

name: check c_payment has cashline-bankline-stageline.sql
content:
/* Formatted on 25/07/2019 04:25:59  (QP5 v5.139.911.3011) */
SELECT P.C_PAYMENT_ID,
       P.DOCUMENTNO payment_no,
       P.PAYAMT,
       P.REMAININGAMOUNT,
       (P.PAYAMT - P.REMAININGAMOUNT) deffamt,
       (CASE WHEN B.LINE > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)  Has_bank_Doc,
       BS.DOCUMENTNO bank_no,
       (CASE WHEN C.LINE > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) Has_Checkstage_Doc,
       CS.DOCUMENTNO checkstage_no,
       (CASE WHEN CL.LINE > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) Has_cash_Doc ,
       CL.AMOUNT cash_amt,
       CA.DOCUMENTNO cash_no
  FROM c_payment p
       LEFT OUTER JOIN C_BANKSTATEMENTline b
          ON B.C_PAYMENT_ID = P.C_PAYMENT_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN C_BANKSTATEMENT bs
          ON BS.C_BANKSTATEMENT_ID = B.C_BANKSTATEMENT_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN C_CheckStageline c
          ON C.C_PAYMENT_ID = P.C_PAYMENT_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN C_CheckStage cs
          ON CS.C_CHECKSTAGE_ID = C.C_CHECKSTAGE_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN c_cashline cl
          ON CL.C_PAYMENT_ID = P.C_PAYMENT_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN c_cash ca
          ON CA.C_CASH_ID = cl.c_cash_id
 WHERE p.c_payment_id IN ();
